system.description:
The Laibon's intimate bond with her inner Beast lets her call its raw strength forth in a controlled fashion, channeling its ferocity into her physical actions. Yet inviting the Beast so close always carries the commensurate risk that it slips the leash entirely.

Concentrate for a turn, then perform a Static Self-Control/Instinct Test (retest Survival) against a difficulty of five Traits. If you win, you may use your Blood Traits as bonus Traits in Physical Challenges for the rest of the scene, dividing them among challenges as you wish — spending none, some or all on any given test — until they are used up. If you fail the test, you may still draw on your Blood Traits this way, but you immediately enter frenzy.
